title: W3C Constraints of the PROV Data Model (PROV-CONSTRAINTS), Recommendation 30 April 2013

w3c-prov-constraints-19.how: W3C's case unification-specialization-f4-FAIL-c52.provn, byte for byte as W3C serves it (app/specs/prov/invalid/spec.json), is an acceptance vector of the prov-invalid guest answered 'invalid 52', and the checker answers 'valid' for it once this rule is switched off (app/specs/prov/spec.json 'shown'); prismpm build runs it and GU-01 holds the pinned wasm to those vectors
